cases.name: next-id: one above the largest id of the base, in a context's own series
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/nid-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/.claude $R/docs $R/todo/feat
cp -R {{KIT}}/examples/docs/business $R/docs/
printf '%s' '{"knowledge": {"contexts": {"Catalog": "CAT", "Studio": "STU"}}}' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/next-id.py Catalog RM; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/next-id.py CAT CU; CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/next-id.py Catalog D

cases.name: next-id: an id held by a spec under todo/ is taken; --count gives consecutive ids
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/nid-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/.claude $R/docs $R/todo/feat
cp -R {{KIT}}/examples/docs/business $R/docs/
printf '%s' '{"knowledge": {"contexts": {"Catalog": "CAT", "Studio": "STU"}}}' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json
printf 'RM new: CAT-RM-007\n' > $R/todo/feat/SPEC-feat.md
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/next-id.py Catalog RM --count 2 | tr '\n' ' '

cases.name: next-id: a retired id survives in HISTORY.md and is never given again
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/nid-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/.claude $R/docs $R/todo/feat
cp -R {{KIT}}/examples/docs/business $R/docs/

printf '| 2026-10-20 | PRD-X | -STU-D-004 |\n' >> $R/docs/business/Catalog/HISTORY.md
CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR=$R python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/next-id.py Studio D

cases.name: validate: one prefix for two contexts is a FAIL, a context folder without prefix a WARN
cases.cmd:
R={{FIX}}/nid-{{SID}}; rm -rf $R; mkdir -p $R/.claude $R/docs $R/todo/feat
cp -R {{KIT}}/examples/docs/business $R/docs/
printf '%s' '{"knowledge": {"contexts": {"Catalog": "CAT", "Studio": "STU"}}}' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json
mkdir -p $R/docs/business/Billing
printf '%s' '{"knowledge": {"contexts": {"Catalog": "CAT", "Studio": "CAT"}}}' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json
python3 {{KIT}}/lib/kit_config.py validate $R | grep knowledge | tr '\n' ' '; printf '%s' '{"knowledge": {"contexts": {"Catalog": "CAT"}}}' > $R/.claude/kit.config.json
python3 {{KIT}}/lib/kit_config.py validate $R | grep knowledge | tr '\n' ' '

expect.stdout: FAIL	knowledge.contexts	prefix CAT given to several contexts WARN	knowledge.contexts	docs/business/Billing has no prefix — add "Billing": "<PREFIX>" ok	knowledge.root	docs/business — 2 contexts
